findings.title: transaction participants from meta are never collected (participantsForMeta reads the TransactionMeta V0 arm)
findings.reproduce: shapekit harness run --chain cap23.claimable-balances.p30 --network testnet --adapter "adapters/bin/wb-adapter --commit e967ce8b7362b79c277e700e789181d76fbb5967"
findings.cause: participantsForMeta switches on `meta.Operations`, the V0 arm of the TransactionMeta union, which is nil for v1 to v4 meta, so accounts that only the meta shows (the sponsor of a claimed or clawed-back claimable balance) are never participants, while accounts only the envelope names (claimants, a payment destination that is the issuer) are. Already reported upstream as #677 (open).

findings.cause: BALANCE rows are written per account; the claimable balance (B) or liquidity pool (L) end of a transfer has no row, so the stored transfer has a null counterparty and the ledger's transfer event to or from the B or L address has no counterpart.

findings.title: to_muxed_id is kept only when it is a u64; a text, hash or return memo carried by the event is lost
findings.reproduce: shapekit harness run --chain classic.memo-bytes.p30 --network testnet --adapter "adapters/bin/wb-adapter --commit e967ce8b7362b79c277e700e789181d76fbb5967"
findings.cause: CAP-67 puts the destination's mux id or, failing that, the transaction memo into the transfer event's `to_muxed_id`, typed as u64, string or bytes. wallet-backend stores `to_muxed_id` only for u64 values, so a transfer whose event carries a text, hash or return memo is stored without it.

findings.title: contract deployments without a matching auth entry (asset contracts, contract-to-contract deploys) record no contract creation
findings.reproduce: shapekit harness run --chain cap73.sac-trust.p28 --network testnet --adapter "adapters/bin/wb-adapter --commit e967ce8b7362b79c277e700e789181d76fbb5967"
findings.cause: Contract creation state changes come from the declared auth invocation tree. A Stellar Asset Contract deployed from an asset, or a contract deployed by another contract with no auth entry for the deployment, creates a contract instance in the meta but no ACCOUNT CREATE row. #746 is the reverse case (rows for deployments that did not happen); both go away when deployments are read from the created contract instances in meta.

findings.title: an XLM transfer through the native asset contract that creates the destination account records no account creation
findings.reproduce: shapekit harness run --chain cap73.sac-trust.p28 --network testnet --adapter "adapters/bin/wb-adapter --commit e967ce8b7362b79c277e700e789181d76fbb5967"
findings.cause: A native SAC transfer to a G address that does not exist creates the account (CAP-73). The meta shows the new account entry; wallet-backend writes the balance credit but no ACCOUNT CREATE row.

findings.title: a pool-share trustline removed by an authorization revocation records no trustline removal
findings.reproduce: shapekit harness run --chain cap38.liquidity-pools.p30 --network testnet --adapter "adapters/bin/wb-adapter --commit e967ce8b7362b79c277e700e789181d76fbb5967"
findings.cause: Revoking authorization with SetTrustLineFlags or AllowTrust redeems the holder's pool shares and removes the pool-share trustline (CAP-38). The removal is in the meta; wallet-backend writes no TRUSTLINE REMOVE for it.

findings.title: a failed transaction that consumes a pre-auth signer records no signer removal
findings.reproduce: shapekit harness run --chain classic.failed-tx.p30 --network testnet --adapter "adapters/bin/wb-adapter --commit e967ce8b7362b79c277e700e789181d76fbb5967"
findings.cause: Core removes a pre-authorized transaction signer when the transaction is applied, even when it fails (txChangesBefore). wallet-backend derives signer changes from operation effects, which exist only for successful transactions, so the removal is not stored.

findings.title: CreateAccount writes a SIGNER ADD for the new account's master key, which the ledger does not show
findings.reproduce: shapekit harness run --chain cap33.sponsorship.p30 --network testnet --adapter "adapters/bin/wb-adapter --commit e967ce8b7362b79c277e700e789181d76fbb5967"
findings.cause: Following Horizon's effects, account creation emits a signer-created state change for the master key. The ledger has no signer entry: the master key's weight is threshold 0 of the account entry, and no signer was added.

findings.title: ContractDeployProcessor walks the declared auth invocation tree with no depth limit (indexerlint IDX002)
findings.reproduce: indexerlint -format json ./... (in a checkout of wallet-backend at e967ce8b7362b79c277e700e789181d76fbb5967)
findings.cause: The walkInvocation closure in (*ContractDeployProcessor).ProcessOperation recurses over xdr.SorobanAuthorizedInvocation with no depth counter. The decoder (depth 1500) and core (transactions nested deeper than 1000 are refused from protocol 28) bound it today, so it is a hardening finding, not a halt.

occurrences.what: IDX002: walkInvocation (closure in (*ContractDeployProcessor).ProcessOperation) recurses over xdr.SorobanAuthorizedInvocation with no depth bound; carry a depth counter and stop at a fixed limit [(*ContractDeployProcessor).ProcessOperation]

findings.title: xdr.DecodeOptions.MaxDepth counts about two levels per nesting, so the sdk decodes envelopes nested deeper than core accepts
findings.reproduce: shapekit conformance run --sdk go --version v0.9.0 --entry soroban.scval-shapes.synth-scvec-depth-247-over-cap
findings.cause: A bare ScVal holds 499 ScVec levels at MaxDepth 1000, while rs-stellar-xdr (and core) spend one level per nesting. At the depth core applies, the sdk accepts auth trees and ScVals that core refuses.

findings.title: strkey decoders before v0.9.0 accept strkeys with carriage returns, newlines or 0xff bytes added
findings.reproduce: shapekit conformance run --sdk go --version v0.8.0 --entry cap27.muxed-accounts.synth-strkey-g-noncanonical-chars
findings.cause: Decode, DecodeAny and Version checked the canonical length on the raw input, then go's encoding/base32 skipped carriage returns and newlines and read 0xff as padding, so such a string decoded to the payload of the strkey it was added to. Fixed in v0.9.0 by #6026, which rejects any byte outside the base32 alphabet first.

findings.title: 17.x decodes with js-xdr 5's limit of 1500 nested types and fromXdr takes no limit, so it accepts transactions nested deeper than core does
findings.reproduce: shapekit conformance run --sdk js --version 17.4.0 --entry soroban.scval-shapes.synth-scvec-depth-247-over-cap
findings.cause: Core refuses envelopes nested deeper than its decode limit; the sdk's default (1500 nested schemas since js-xdr#155) is wider and cannot be lowered through fromXdr, so the sdk accepts and re-encodes values core refuses.

findings.title: the XDR-JSON reader stops at serde_json's 128-level recursion limit, so values the crate renders cannot be read back
findings.reproduce: shapekit conformance run --sdk rust --version 30.0.0 --entry soroban.scval-shapes.synth-event-vec-depth-101
findings.cause: to_xdr_json renders nested values of any depth the decoder accepts, but the reader uses serde_json with its default recursion limit, so deep auth trees, ScVals and events (including ones on recorded protocol 30 ledgers) do not round-trip through JSON.
